# Leal's Tire Shop

> Tire shop based in Austin, Texas. The big yellow shop on East 7th. Pull in with a flat, a set of worn tires or a dually that needs new rubber, and the guys at Leal's will walk you through your options and get you back on the road.

- Phone: (512) 477-6180
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: Austin, Del Valle, Manor, Pflugerville, Round Rock
- Google rating: 4.2 from 893 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tire-shops/texas/leals-tire-shop/quote.html
- Plan your visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tire-shops/texas/leals-tire-shop/book.html

## Services
- Flat repair: Picked up a nail or a screw? Pull in and we'll check the tire and patch it if it can be repaired.
- Used tires: Good used tires and high-tread take-offs in a lot of sizes, for a lot less than new. Cash only.
- New tires: New tires when you want them. Tell us your size and we'll tell you what we can get.
- Truck & dually tires: It's right on our pole sign: TRUCK TIRE REPAIRS. Work trucks, pickups and duallys welcome.
- Mounting & balancing: Tires mounted and balanced on our Coats machines while you wait.
- Wheels: Customers roll out on new wheels too, from dually setups to aftermarket rims.

## About
Leal's Tire Shop is the loud yellow building at 3502 E 7th St, with LEAL'S painted in red across the front and TIRE SHOP in blue. Across the lot, the pole sign says what we do: TRUCK TIRE REPAIRS. We're open seven days a week, which is why people with a flat on a Sunday morning find their way to us. Customers come in for flat repairs, good used tires, new tires, and truck and dually work, and they keep telling the same story in their reviews: friendly guys, options explained, in and out fast. No fancy waiting room, just a covered bay, a rack of tires and a crew that knows them. Pull in, tell us what's going on, and we'll get you rolling.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday through Friday 7:30 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday and Sunday 8 AM to 6 PM. We're open seven days a week.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Most customers just pull in while we're open. If you need a specific size, call (512) 477-6180 first and we'll check what we have.
- Q: Do you take cards for used tires?
  A: Used tires are cash only, so come ready for that. Ask at the counter about payment for new tires and repairs.
- Q: Do you work on trucks and duallys?
  A: Yes. Truck tire repairs are on our sign, and we mount and balance tires and wheels for pickups, work trucks and duallys.
- Q: Can you fix my flat?
  A: Bring it in. We'll check the tire, and if it's repairable we'll patch it. If it isn't, we'll show you your options.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 3502 E 7th St, Austin, TX 78702, in East Austin. Look for the big yellow building and the pole sign that says TRUCK TIRE REPAIRS.
